The '''Followers of Baba''' were a group [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thugs that was formed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Operating from a secret base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], the Followers of Baba raided a number of local towns over a period of several weeks. The [[Corellian Security Force]], a law enforcement agency, decided that if it got directly involved in stopping the Follows' attacks, it would just worsen the situation, so instead, the CorSec [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Mark Hieks]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to take out Baba. The spacer encountered the Followers during an attack that they had launched on a town, and the individual captured Baba and handed him over to CorSec.

The Followers of Baba also recruited several [[Lost Aqualish]] outriders to act as [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]].<ref name="LAO">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Lost Aqualish Outrider}}</ref>
